name: Unbowed Leadership
body:
Your determination inspires and invigorates your followers to resist forces that would otherwise break their convictions.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, character level 7th, and you must possess at least 1 class feature that grants a bonus to saving throws against charm, compulsion, or fear effects.

Benefit: Any time you are gaining a bonus from one of your class features to your saving throws against charm, compulsion, or fear effects, you grant this same bonus to any creatures under your command from the Leadership feat (or variant thereof) within line of sight to you. You can only grant this bonus from one of your class features at a time in this manner. The effects of this feat do not apply if you are currently under a charm, compulsion, or fear effect.
